title: Edit Video by Typing
subtitle: How AI turns text commands into finished video
intro: You saved a post that says "RIP Video Editing" — 12 tools now let you edit just by typing. How does typing replace dragging clips on a timeline?
takeaway: AI video editing turns your words into edits, so you type what you want instead of cutting it by hand.

sections.heading: Everyday analogy: editing video like a Word doc
sections.body:
Imagine your video is a Word document. Instead of cutting film with scissors, you just delete a sentence and the video updates.

That is transcript-based editing. The AI writes out what was said as text, and when you edit the text, it edits the video to match.

This one idea powers the rest, so let's see why it exists.

sections.heading: Why does this exist? From hours of clicks to one sentence
sections.body:
Normal editing means manual cuts, removing silences, and syncing. AI does this from a command.

- Text-to-video generation: you type a prompt and the AI makes new video from it.
- AI avatar cloning: you type a script and a tool like HeyGen speaks it as your digital double — the creator in your save got 50M+ views this way.
- Chat-style editing: you type "remove silences" or "pick a smooth style" and a tool like Mirage does the cuts.

Faster is great, but typing has limits.

sections.heading: What can go wrong? When the AI guesses wrong
sections.body:
An AI avatar is a computer copy of a face and voice that says your script. It can look fake if lighting or emotion is off.

Text-to-video can also mishear you and add the wrong clip, and auto-cuts can remove a pause you wanted for drama.

So you still need to check the result, because speed without control can hurt your story.

steps.narration: You type: remove silence or make avatar say this.
AI matches your words to the transcript of the video.
AI cuts, generates, or clones the avatar to match.
You watch and fix where AI guessed wrong.

quiz.q: What does transcript-based editing let you do?
options: Edit video by editing its written text
Add more storage to your laptop
quiz.why: The AI transcribes speech to text, so deleting text deletes that video part.

quiz.q: What can go wrong if you rely only on typing commands?
options: AI may cut important pauses or make avatar look fake
quiz.why: Auto silence removal and generation can misinterpret intent and need human review.

quiz.q: What is AI avatar cloning as shown with HeyGen?
options: Typing a script for a digital copy of you to speak
Hiring an actor to mimic you
quiz.why: HeyGen lets you clone yourself so the avatar speaks your typed text.
